concerns.text: The synthetic dataset generates the measured residual stress directly from the same process parameters that are later used as predictors (μ_res = 0.7·heat_input + 0.3·cooling_rate + ε). Consequently, the mediation analysis (Section 6) tests a mediator that is mathematically derived from the predictors, making the indirect effect essentially predetermined by the data‑generation model. This creates a circular/tautological validation: the analysis can only confirm the hypothesised mediation because the data were constructed to embed it, not because an independent empirical relationship is demonstrated.
